Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the business and occupation tax of wholesale sales of motor vehicle and special fuels.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the business and occupation tax of wholesalesales of motor vehicle and special fuels; and adding a new section tochapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a motorvehicle fuel distributor from another motor vehicle fuel distributorfrom wholesale sales of petroleum products for resale to an end user. (2) This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a specialfuel distributor from another special fuel distributor from wholesalesales of petroleum products for resale to an end user. (3) As used in this section: (a) "Motor vehicle fuel distributor" has the meaning provided inRCW 82.36.010; and (b) "Special fuel distributor" has the meaning provided in RCW82.38.020.
